name: publish_arrival
description: Validate a lani.arrival/v0 arrival (the introduction dialog of someone who joined the village) and publish it to the app: it replaces the template for that newcomer or baby (or the culture pack's for a cast member, until remove_arrival). Returns validation errors instead of publishing if invalid. Load the lani-studio skill before using. Say the learner {learner} and what agrees with them {m:…|f:…} (companion/SCENES.md, the learner in the content). A spoken line, a choice's reply and a turn's puzzled may carry "face" (happy, laugh, surprised, curious, confused, thinking, worried, sad, cross, shy, proud; never neutral, the resting face): the speaker's expression, only where the line carries a feeling (companion/SCENES.md, "Faces").

note.description: One-line announcement shown in the app
